why: Traetta's 2024 paper 'A constructive solution to the Oberwolfach problem with a large cycle' settles a class of instances of the exact problem beyond the 2018 asymptotic (large-n) resolution; other 2024 work also completes the directed variant's uniform-length cases, suggesting continued case-by-case progress on the exact (all n) problem post-snapshot.
